newsitem.title: USA: ITI Technologies adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: ITI Technologies adopts rights plan.

text.p: ITI Technologies Inc said on Wednesday that it adopted a stockholder rights plan to protect shareholders from unsolicited attempts or inequitable offers to acquire the company.
President Thomas Auth said in a statement: "The rights agreement was not adopted in response to any specific effort to acquire control of the company."
ITI said its board declared a dividend distribution of one common stock purchase right on each outstanding share of the ITI's common stock outstanding on December 9, 1996.

Each right will entitle stockholders to buy one-half share of ITI's common stock at an exercise price of $25. The rights will become exercisable under certain conditions, such as when a person or group announces the acquisition of 20 percent or more of ITI's common stock.
The dividend distribution will be made to holders of record on December 9. The rights will expire in 10 years on November 26, 2006.
ITI said the rights plan has no immediate dilutive effect and does not diminish the ability of the company, or its stockholders to accept a fair offer for ITI.
ITI will be entitled to redeem the rights at $0.001 per right at certain times provided in the agreement.
The company manufacturers wireless communications products.
